body:
Just to clarify a bit more what @pixelastic said. I don't think the instantsearch.js module should style components (meaning manipulating the style of widgets).

Why? Because it's always a fail (conflicts, css cascade, overwriting ..) and people will want to either remove all style, provide templates following other methodologies (like bootstrap) or disable it.

Thus if the JS is doing some style by default then it will be hard to overwrite it/provide a good API for it.

We rather go the jqueryUI way (or any UI library) by having some methodologies for class names (BEM) and providing a way to load default stylesheets (then more advanced ones maybe).

But no default stylesheet should be loaded.

It will either load it via JS or the user will have to put it in a <link rel... JS loading seems the most easiest way right now.

Also I have set it to milestone "1.0.0" because for now, to build the 0.0.1 (instant search demo), we do not need that much and we are not sure how much of CSS intelligence we need until we have the complete demo/start to implement the might magento extension.
